name: Cinderkin
trait: Once each minute, regain a small shield after taking fire or ember damage.
ethos: Families inscribe the names of their lost into coal-fired clay.
hook: Your family hearth speaks a name outlawed by the Archive.

name: Fenborn
trait: Brief movement-speed gain after passing through slow terrain.
ethos: Fenspeople cultivate reed tablets that preserve a memory until rainfall.
hook: The wetland reflects a settlement that drowned before it existed.

name: Stonebound
trait: A short stagger-resistance buff after being hit by an elite enemy.
ethos: Mountain communities carve genealogies into staircases, never individual statues.
hook: The ancestral steps are speaking a family name that has not been carved.

name: Skyforged
trait: A small resource restoration after a successful dodge.
ethos: Cliff dwellers tell histories in wind instruments played only at funerals.
hook: A wind-chime repeats a melody that nobody living has composed.
